user.title: Nexus System Local
user.description:
Your Nexus System devices publish their own entities on your MQTT broker: they appear through the MQTT integration. Nexus System Local adds each device's local link, the "Send to a Nexus device" action and diagnostics.

**{count} device(s) found on the broker:**
{devices}

None? Set the broker in the Nexus System app (the device's local configuration), then come back.

abort.already_configured: Nexus System Local is already set up: it follows every device on the broker.
abort.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration first (for example with the Mosquitto add-on).

mqtt_discovery_disabled.title: MQTT discovery disabled
mqtt_discovery_disabled.description: The entities of Nexus System devices (readings, settings, controls) come from MQTT discovery, which is disabled in the MQTT integration. Turn it back on: Settings › Devices & services › MQTT › Configure › Enable discovery.

send.name: Send to a Nexus device
send.description: Sends a setting or a command to a Nexus System device over the local network. The device applies the same checks as the app and answers with the nexus_system_local_result event.

data.name: Data
data.description: JSON object the device accepts (see the "Local MQTT and home automation" documentation page), for example {"outputs": {"lights": true}}.

unknown_device.message: {device} is not a Nexus System device seen on the broker.

not_loaded.message: Nexus System Local is not loaded.
